reading_sentence: The librarian stacked the returned books on the metal cart.
A small dog chased the red ball across the wet grass.
The teacher wrote the homework assignment on the whiteboard.
Fresh bread was cooling on the kitchen counter near the window.
The bus driver waited patiently at the crowded corner stop.
Two children built a tall sandcastle close to the water.
The old clock in the hallway chimed twelve times at midnight.
A gardener watered the roses early in the cool morning.
The pilot announced that the plane would land in twenty minutes.
The mechanic replaced the worn tires on the delivery truck.
A waiter carried three plates of pasta to the corner table.
The students lined up quietly outside the gymnasium door.
